title: biosig-zarr format version 3: events group metadata document
description: The zarr.json of the events group of a format version 3 store, transcribed from spec/index.md on the branch draft/3.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two documents, such as n_events and the length of the event arrays, are not expressed. Unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Events group: the root group MUST contain a group named events.

node_type.$comment: Events group: events is a group.

attributes.$comment: Events group: the REQUIRED rows of the events attribute table.

label_map.description: Events group: a map from an event code, written as a decimal string, to its description.

propertyNames.$comment: Events group: an event code, written as a decimal string. The text says only decimal; that a minus sign is allowed and that leading zeros are allowed are inferences of this schema, not statements of the text. Whether the value fits the int32 code array is not checked.

additionalProperties.description: Events group: the code's description; the text gives no type, and a description is taken to be a string.

onset_source_basis.$comment: Events group: how the source counted onsets, timeline, concatenated, or unknown.

label_map.description: Events group: label_map is empty when n_events is 0.
